_comment: CW single-track 316L calibration. Thermophysical params calibrated ONCE, shared across both cases; only process params (P, v, radius) and geometry differ per case. Edit ranges/budget here.

objective._comment: Per case: error = mean(|depth_err|, |width_err|). Candidate objective = mean over both cases. Lower is better.

optimizer._comment: 16 candidates total (baseline + 15 LHS). Each candidate runs BOTH cases.

parameters._comment: Shared thermophysical knobs. elec_resistivity scalar; cp/kappa are multiplicative scales on the whole table; rho scalar; beta_r scalar.

geometry._comment: Common geometry constants in metres. Per-case y/z extents computed from these + process/target.

earlyAbort._comment: Abort a running sim only once its melt-pool has STABILIZED (rel change of last two points < stabilityTol) AND error > 50% — avoids killing pools that are still growing. If a candidate's first case ends > 50% off, its second case is skipped.

execution._comment: maxParallel = floor(totalCores / coresPerSim). Override with env CALIB_TOTAL_CORES / CALIB_CORES_PER_SIM (HPC sets these). of2506 apptainer wrapper + host PYTHON taken from env OF2506_IMAGE / OF2506_USER / PYTHON (same as job.sh).
